_info.descripcion: Field Shift crop catalog, version 1 (Sonora). Each value states its source.

region.descripcion: Planting dates, water, yield and management risks come from INIFAP for Sonora. Outside this region the app estimates dates from the local NASA POWER climate.

notas: Water: 1 cm of irrigation depth = 100 m³ per hectare.
ECOCROP temperatures are the AVERAGE temperature of the growing season, not the daily maximum.
Kc (crop coefficient) from FAO-24 Table 21 for wind of 0 to 5 m/s: 'humedo' = minimum relative humidity > 70 %; 'seco' = minimum relative humidity < 20 %. For an intermediate climate, interpolate.
null = the source doesn't provide the value; it was not made up.

fuentes.INIFAP: INIFAP (2026). Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Sonora 2026. Campo Experimental Norman E. Borlaug, CIRNO. File: Fuentes de cultivos/14858_5722_Agenda_Técnica_Agrícola_2026_Sonora.pdf
fuentes.FAO-24: Doorenbos, J. and Pruitt, W. O. (1977, reprinted 1992). Crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 24. File: Fuentes de cultivos/FAO_Water_requirement_Sonora.pdf
fuentes.SIAP: SIAP (2025). Year-end agricultural production by municipality 2025. File: Fuentes de cultivos/Cierre_agricola_mun_2025.csv

ventanas.nota: It can be planted until late December, but yield drops the further you get from the recommended date.

agua.detalle: Pre-planting; 1st follow-up irrigation ~50 days after planting (tillering-jointing); 2nd ~30 days later (start of heading); 3rd ~20 days later (grain filling).

riesgos.texto: Frost from late December to February in southern Sonora.

rotacion.detalle: Requires ~30 kg of nitrogen per tonne of grain (~210 kg N/ha for 7 t/ha).

ciclo_dias.nota: Days to physiological maturity depending on the variety.

notas: Durum wheat covered 75 % of Sonora's wheat area in the 2023-2024 season (INIFAP 2026, p. 124).

superficie_sonora_2025_ha.fuente: SIAP 2025 (grain corn; 9,762 ha in fall-winter and 2,225 ha in spring-summer)

ventanas.nota: Plantings in January and early February have less frost risk, but are exposed to the April and May heat, which can greatly reduce yield.

agua.detalle: Pre-planting irrigation of ~25 cm (10 to 15 days before planting) and 5 follow-up irrigations of ~14 cm, at stages V6, V11, R1, R3 and R5.

riesgos.texto: Frost from late December to February.
April and May heat in late plantings.

rotacion.detalle: The Agenda's fertilization program: more than 280 kg of N/ha split between pre-planting and follow-up irrigations.

ciclo_dias.nota: The Agenda doesn't give the total cycle length.

ventanas.nota: Late plantings favor pests such as the stem borer and stink bugs.

agua.detalle: Normal: pre-planting irrigation of 20-25 cm and 3 follow-up irrigations of ~12 cm. With little water: pre-planting of ~20 cm and 1 or 2 follow-ups of 10 cm.

riesgos.texto: Diseases (root rot, downy mildew, leaf spot) with cloudy days, rain, high humidity or heavy irrigation.

rotacion.detalle: The nitrogen dose depends on the previous crop and the soil type (the Agenda has a table by rotation).

ciclo_dias.nota: Days to physiological maturity for commercial varieties; harvest is 140 to 190 days after planting.

notas: It tolerates little water: with 1 or 2 follow-up irrigations it is still viable (INIFAP 2026, pp. 47-48).

ventanas.nota: Earlier plantings have more frost risk; later ones, more heat and pests, and produce smaller grain.

agua.detalle: Pre-planting and 2 follow-up irrigations (schedule 0-45-65 or 0-55-75 days depending on the soil): total depth of ~40 to 44 cm.

riesgos.texto: Frost in early plantings and heat in late plantings.
Root rot with waterlogging: use light irrigations on clay soils.

rotacion.detalle: Legume: fixes nitrogen from the air, which benefits the next crop. Pending: cite with the team's rotation guides.
rotacion.fuente: General agronomic knowledge (to be confirmed with a reference)

rendimiento.unidad: t/ha of grain (furrow irrigation; 3.0-3.5 with drip)

ciclo_dias.nota: Growing cycle of the region's varieties.

notas: Rotating with crops that don't host root fungi helps control them (INIFAP 2026, p. 82).

superficie_sonora_2025_ha.fuente: SIAP 2025 (2,183 ha in fall-winter and 1,241 ha in spring-summer)

ventanas.nota: Plantings after October 5 are at risk of frost.
Optimal period: last week of January and first week of February.

agua.detalle: Pre-planting and 4 follow-up irrigations at 40, 60, 75 and 85 days (depths of 15, 12, 10 and 8 cm); total depth of 40 to 45 cm.

riesgos.texto: Damage from temperatures above 30 °C during the reproductive stage.

rotacion.detalle: Legume: fixes nitrogen from the air. Even so, the Agenda recommends 90-120 kg of N/ha. Rotating with grasses helps reduce diseases.
rotacion.fuente: INIFAP 2026, pp. 67 and 69; N fixation: general agronomic knowledge (to be confirmed)

rendimiento.unidad: t/ha of grain (Sonora average 2020-2024; potential with good water management)

ciclo_dias.nota: Fall-winter cycle from planting to harvest (in spring-summer, 100 to 108 days).

superficie_sonora_2025_ha.fuente: SIAP 2025 (green forage sorghum; plus 1,751 ha of grain sorghum)

ventanas.nota: It grows from 16 °C up; the optimal temperature is 25 °C.

agua.detalle: Depth of 80 to 150 cm depending on soil texture. It needs less water than corn, but is sensitive to water shortage during early growth, boot stage, flowering and grain filling.

riesgos.texto: It doesn't grow below 16 °C: it's a summer crop.

rotacion.detalle: 80 to 100 kg of N/ha, plus 50 kg of N/ha after each grazing.

rendimiento.unidad: t/ha of green forage at the first cut (~50 days)

ciclo_dias.nota: First cut at ~50 days; it can give several cuts.

notas: It's the only summer crop in the catalog.

ventanas.nota: In late plantings aphid damage increases, the cycle shortens and grain and oil yield drop.

agua.detalle: The heaviest possible pre-planting irrigation (25-30 cm) and, if needed, a 10-12 cm follow-up at the start of flowering (55-65 days). On soils that hold little moisture, a 2nd follow-up at the end of flowering (89-95 days).

riesgos.texto: Aphids in late plantings during flowering.

rotacion.detalle: Nitrogen is applied 50 % at pre-planting and 50 % at rosette; not later.

rendimiento.unidad: t/ha of grain (potential of early varieties)

ciclo_dias.nota: The Agenda doesn't give the total cycle length.

notas: It's hardly planted in Sonora (15 ha in 2025).
